title: Roasted Banana Blondies
changes_from_base: Roasted mashed banana and warm spices in a creamed batter, with dark chocolate.
summary: Creamed blondies with roasted mashed banana, warm spices and dark chocolate.
equipment: 23 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling
electric hand whisk or wooden spoon

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 100 g for the batter, 40 g for the top

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan). Put the whole unpeeled bananas on a lined tray and roast 15-20 min, until the skins are black and the flesh is soft. Cool, then peel and mash.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat the butter with both sugars until light, then beat in the egg, vanilla and mashed banana.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Whisk the flour, salt, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg, then stir them in until no flour shows. Fold in 100 g of the chocolate.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the lined tin, scatter the remaining chocolate on top and bake 35-40 min, until golden and a skewer comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 16.

tips: Roasting the bananas concentrates their flavour, so even firm ones work.
Let the bananas cool before adding them to the butter.
Cut with a hot knife for neat squares.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
